profile.name: Zhouxing Zhao (赵周行)
profile.headline: R&D Director | Chief Architect | AI, Data & Cloud-Edge Systems
profile.summary: Zhouxing Zhao works on AI engineering, data governance, low-altitude UAV applications, cloud-edge collaboration, and intelligent scheduling systems. His work connects enterprise architecture, research-driven product development, and large-scale engineering delivery across digital transformation scenarios.

highlights.text: Recognized with the Most Beautiful Science and Technology Worker honor by China Telecom Association for Science and Technology.
Led and participated in key projects on professional UAV R&D, data-driven code assembly, cloud-edge intelligent cores, and enterprise data governance.
Team achievements include recognition for Zhejiang Multimodal Intelligent IoT Communication Technology Key Enterprise Research Institute and Zhejiang Comservice advanced team.
Recognized as Excellent Architect by Zhejiang Smart City Promotion Association.

experience.organization: China Communications Services / Zhejiang Communications Services
bullets: Leads AI and data product R&D, digital transformation architecture, and cross-provincial delivery.
Built an AI capability platform and a 50-person AI R&D team with engineering standards and documentation practices.
Designed low-code, data asset, and reusable component architectures to reduce integration complexity.

experience.organization: Hangzhou Shuopan Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
bullets: Managed a 40-person R&D team and built master-data and foundational-data systems with TOGAF enterprise architecture methods.
Used data fabric and application assembly practices to shorten enterprise product delivery cycles.
Built DevOps and continuous integration systems from the ground up.
Led B2B DevOps platform construction from zero to one and reduced application release time significantly.
Designed KMS architecture for large-scale attachment data and intelligent permission management.
Managed software product BOM systems and received Hikvision's Golden Brick Award for two consecutive years.

education.details: Research focus: automatic control theory and applications.

projects.title: Professional UAV R&D and Applications for Typical Low-Altitude Scenarios
projects.summary: Developed a professional UAV platform for urban security, emergency communications, perception scheduling, intelligent recognition, and task collaboration in low-altitude scenarios.
projects.outcome: Built a unified scheduling platform for heterogeneous UAVs and improved real-time response capabilities in complex environments.

projects.title: Data-Driven Code Assembly Platform
projects.summary: Led an automated code assembly platform based on data-driven reuse, component reuse, modular repositories, and knowledge graphs.
projects.outcome: The platform improved average R&D efficiency by more than 30% according to the personal statement.

projects.title: Cloud-Edge Intelligent Core for Integrated Sensing and Collaborative Dispatching
projects.summary: Designed cloud-edge intelligent core architecture and lightweight AI inference technologies for constrained terminals, reducing AI processing latency and bandwidth usage in pilot applications.

projects.title: Key Technologies for Photovoltaic Cloud-Edge-Device Collaborative Intelligent Response
projects.summary: Researched cloud-edge-device collaboration for photovoltaic scenarios, including edge real-time monitoring, cloud scheduling, terminal response, and predictive maintenance.
projects.outcome: The personal statement records reported sales revenue of RMB 1 billion from this achievement.

documents.title: Professional Experience
documents.summary: Work experience spanning China Communications Services, Hangzhou Shuopan Intelligent Technology, and Hikvision.
documents.text: Professional Experience 专业经历 China Communications Services / Zhejiang Communications Services R&D Director and Chief Architect, May 2023 to present. 研发总监、首席架构师，2023年5月至今。 Zhouxing Zhao leads AI and data product R&D, digital transformation architecture, and cross-provincial delivery. He built an AI capability platform, organized a 50-person AI R&D team, and promoted engineering standards, reusable components, and technical documentation systems. 负责人工智能与数据产品研发、数字化转型架构和跨省交付；建设人工智能能力平台和50人人工智能研发团队，推动工程规范、可复用组件与技术文档体系建设。 Hangzhou Shuopan Intelligent Technology Head of R&D Center, April 2021 to May 2023. 研发中心负责人，2021年4月至2023年5月。 He managed a 40-person R&D team, built master-data and foundational-data systems with TOGAF enterprise architecture methods, and used data fabric and application assembly practices to shorten enterprise software delivery cycles. 管理40人研发团队，采用TOGAF企业架构方法建设主数据与基础数据系统，并通过数据织构和应用组装实践缩短企业软件交付周期。 Hikvision Digital Technology Senior Manager, July 2015 to April 2021. 高级经理，2015年7月至2021年4月。 He led the construction of a B2B DevOps platform, designed large-scale KMS architecture for attachment data and intelligent permission management, managed software product BOM systems, and received Hikvision's Golden Brick Award for two consecutive years. 负责从零建设B2B DevOps平台，设计面向大规模附件数据与智能权限管理的KMS架构，管理软件产品BOM体系，并连续两年获得海康威视金砖奖。

documents.title: Zhouxing Zhao - Public Profile Overview
documents.summary: A public English overview of Zhouxing Zhao's background, research interests, and professional profile.
documents.text: Zhouxing Zhao - Public Profile Overview 赵周行公开资料概览 Zhouxing Zhao is an R&D Director and Chief Architect based in Hangzhou, China. His work focuses on AI engineering, data governance, low-altitude UAV applications, cloud-edge collaboration, heterogeneous computing, and intelligent scheduling systems. 赵周行现居中国杭州，任研发总监、首席架构师，主要从事人工智能工程、数据治理、低空无人机应用、云边协同、异构计算与智能调度系统研究。 He currently works at Zhejiang Communications Services Co., Ltd. His public profile combines enterprise architecture, engineering management, research-oriented product development, and digital transformation delivery. 目前任职于浙江省通信产业服务有限公司。公开资料覆盖企业架构、研发管理、研究型产品开发和数字化转型交付。 Research and engineering interests include computer vision, large model applications, data governance, cloud-edge-device collaboration, low-altitude economy scenarios, UAV scheduling, DevOps platforms, knowledge graphs, and heterogeneous computing resource scheduling. 研究与工程方向包括计算机视觉、大模型应用、数据治理、云边端协同、低空经济场景、无人机调度、DevOps平台、知识图谱和异构计算资源调度。

documents.title: Representative Research and Engineering Projects
documents.summary: Detailed project achievements in low-altitude UAV systems, data-driven code assembly, cloud-edge intelligent cores, and photovoltaic cloud-edge-device collaboration.
documents.text: Representative Research and Engineering Projects 代表性科研与工程项目 Professional UAV R&D and Applications for Typical Low-Altitude Scenarios 面向典型低空场景的专业化无人机研发与应用 Period: 2025 to 2026. 周期：2025年至2026年。 Role: Core contributor, rank 4/30. 角色：核心贡献者，第4/30位。 Achievement: Developed a professional UAV platform for urban security, emergency communications, perception scheduling, intelligent recognition, and task collaboration. Built a unified scheduling platform for heterogeneous UAVs, supporting collaborative operation across different aircraft types. 成果：面向城市安防、应急通信、感知调度、智能识别和任务协同研发专业化无人机平台，建立异构无人机统一调度平台，支持不同类型飞行器协同作业。 Technical focus: target detection, behavior recognition, intelligent scheduling algorithms, multi-mode navigation, anti-interference control, and real-time response in complex low-altitude environments. 技术重点：目标检测、行为识别、智能调度算法、多模态导航、抗干扰控制和复杂低空环境下的实时响应。 Data-Driven Code Assembly Platform 基于数据驱动的代码组装平台 Period: 2023 to 2025. 周期：2023年至2025年。 Role: Project lead, rank 1/40. 角色：项目负责人，第1/40位。 Achievement: Led an automated code assembly platform based on data-driven reuse, component reuse, modular code repositories, and knowledge graphs. The platform supports rapid component matching and intelligent assembly. 成果：主持建设以数据复用、组件复用、模块化代码仓库和知识图谱为基础的自动化代码组装平台，支持快速组件匹配与智能组装。 Reported outcome: the platform improved average R&D efficiency by more than 30% according to the personal statement. 成果表现：据个人陈述，平台使平均研发效率提升30%以上。 Cloud-Edge Intelligent Core for Integrated Sensing and Collaborative Dispatching 面向感知融合与协同调度的云边智核 Period: 2025 to 2026. 周期：2025年至2026年。 Role: Architecture lead. 角色：架构负责人。 Achievement: Designed cloud-edge intelligent core architecture and lightweight AI inference technologies for constrained terminals. 成果：面向受限终端设计云边智核架构和轻量化人工智能推理技术。 Technical focus: low-latency AI inference, cloud-edge-device collaboration, heterogeneous computing scheduling, and integrated sensing and dispatching. 技术重点：低时延人工智能推理、云边端协同、异构计算调度以及感知与调度融合。 Key Technologies for Photovoltaic Cloud-Edge-Device Collaborative Intelligent Response 光伏云边端协同智能响应关键技术研究与应用 Period: 2024 to 2025. 周期：2024年至2025年。 Role: Project lead. 角色：项目负责人。 Achievement: Researched cloud-edge-device collaboration in photovoltaic scenarios, including edge-side real-time monitoring, cloud-side intelligent scheduling, terminal response, and predictive maintenance models. 成果：研究光伏场景下的云边端协同，包括边缘实时监测、云端智能调度、端侧快速响应和预测性维护模型。 Reported outcome: the personal statement records reported sales revenue of RMB 1 billion from this achievement. 成果表现：个人陈述记载该成果带来十亿元销售收入。
